verdict.rationale: Loops documents a no-code visual editor with an editing guide. Brand colors, type, and spacing are set once as themes and applied automatically to every email. Per-recipient dynamic variables like {contact.firstName} resolve at send time, and LMX lets content authored in code stay in sync with the visual editor while Loops handles the HTML. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cross-client rendering correctness or preview/testing, documentation of a reusable saved-template library beyond themes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor experience.
